svg.aria-label: Finder, disclosure platform and maintainer quokkas with the statement, verification and countersignature arrows between them
svg.title: Disclosure flow with VSLA
svg.text: The finder claims a level; the platform verifies one; the maintainer countersigns the outcome, which feeds the finder's history.
ledger entry → the finder's trust history
What the platform verifies before it believes a level
DSSE sig by a pinned finder key; nonce, expiry
recompute the Merkle root from the sealed leaves
re-run the failing test in its own sandbox; exit 1
statement names this intake; ledger root ok; score ≥ floor
quote verifies vs. vendor root; measurement matches
Both parties keep a signed audit chain; a dispute about who knew what, when, is settled by the chains, not by memory.
